depends_on.name: filter_id
depends_on.documentation: Optional: the frequency filter these samples passed through. See V_eta_frequency_filter_model_plan.md.

fields.name: byte_order
fields.documentation: 'little' | 'big' -- the order of bytes WITHIN one datum. REQUIRED in practice whenever `data_type` is multi-byte; meaningless, and left empty, for single-byte data.

fields.name: fill_value
fields.documentation: What every position of a MISSING chunk holds, for a body whose file series omits members (`complete` is deleted, data_body plan AMENDMENT 6 [no complete]): ONE value, written as a literal read according to the owner's `data_type` ("NaN", "-32768", "1+2j") -- exact for every datum type, which a double is not for int64/uint64 or complex (#73 audit 2 D13).

rules.name: datum_order_multidimensional
rules.statement: A sampled body with more than one dimension states `datum_order` ('C' or 'F'); with one dimension or none it is left empty (Jess Haley 2026-10-22 [covariate rules named] 6.3a; named by [audit mechanical fixes 2]).
